verdict.rationale: New Relic AI (docs-9, docs-10) lets users ask questions and troubleshoot issues in plain language, and the MCP server (docs-11, docs-22) exposes platform context to AI tools, which supports AI-assisted incident triage — but no evidence explicitly shows auto-generated incident summaries or alert-specific responder context. Missing for 10: explicit incident-summary generation feature, alert-context packaging for responders, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
